definitions.short: Ethan , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H387. Ethan II. אֵיתָן proper name, masculine a wise man 1Kin 5:11 (where called הָאֶזְרָחִי ) named with דַּרְדַּע כַּלְכֹּל, הֵימָן, ; compare 1Chr 2:6 (where these 4 with זִמְרִי are זֶרַח בְּנֵי ); also 2:8 ; 6:27 ; called בֶּןקִֿישִׁי 6:29 = בֶּןקֿוּשָׁיָ֫הוּ 15:17 ; where, and 15:19 , named as Levitical singer with הֵימָן and אָסָף (q. v.; יְדוּתוּן for אֵיתָן in this group 25:1 , 6 ; 2Chr 5:12 ; 35:15 , see ידותון ); הָאֶזְרָחִי לְאֵיתָן Psa 89:1 (title). יַתְנִיאֵל see תנה .
